calibration: Timing verified against current owners. Probe scenarios and marginal effects are controlled assumptions, not calibrated role balance envelopes.

assumptions: Timing and stamina envelope only, not a complete movement or defense valuation.
Every scheduled roll finds a legal path and the caster survives; actual hazards, blocked movement, attacks, healing and competing stamina spending are omitted.
At most one roll per activation, 40TU interval, fixed 60 stamina; no movement cells or prevented HP are assigned an invented value.
Proposed numbers are an unapproved author design, not current gameplay.
cases.policy: instant; at most one cast/activation; earliest legal recast; no regeneration
